events.title: 코시아라투르의 농가에서 태어나다
events.title_en: Born on a farm in Cauchy-à-la-Tour
events.description: 프랑스 북부 코시아라투르에서 농민의 아들로 태어났다.
events.description_en: He was born to a farming family in Cauchy-à-la-Tour in northern France.

events.title: 생시르 육군사관학교를 마치다
events.title_en: He graduated from Saint-Cyr military academy
events.description: 생시르 육군사관학교를 졸업하고 장교의 길에 들어섰다. 이후 오랫동안 진급이 더뎌 전쟁 전까지 대령에 머물렀다.
events.description_en: He graduated from the Saint-Cyr military academy and became an officer. Promotion came slowly, and he remained a colonel until the eve of the war.

events.title: 육군대학에서 화력 중심 교리를 가르치다
events.title_en: He taught firepower doctrine at the École de Guerre
events.description: 육군대학 교관으로 오래 재직하며 화력이 돌격을 이긴다는 방어 중심 전술을 가르쳤다. 당시 프랑스군 주류였던 공세 지상주의와 어긋나 냉대받았다.
events.description_en: He spent years as an instructor at the École de Guerre, teaching that firepower defeats the bayonet charge. This defensive doctrine clashed with the offensive-minded orthodoxy of the French army and cost him standing.

events.title: 베르됭을 지켜 국민적 영웅이 되다
events.title_en: He held Verdun and became a national hero
events.description: 독일군의 총공세가 쏟아진 베르됭 방어전을 지휘했다. 프랑스군은 끝내 요새를 지켜냈고, 그는 이 전투로 국민적 영웅이 되었다.
events.description_en: He commanded the defense of Verdun against a massive German offensive. The French army held the fortress in the end, and the battle made him a national hero.

events.title: 프랑스군 총사령관이 되어 반란을 수습하다
events.title_en: He became commander-in-chief and quelled the mutinies
events.description: 니벨 공세가 실패한 뒤 프랑스군에서 대규모 항명이 번지자 총사령관을 맡았다. 처벌보다 병사들의 처우 개선으로 군을 다시 추슬렀다.
events.description_en: After the failed Nivelle Offensive triggered widespread mutinies in the French army, he took over as commander-in-chief. He calmed the army less through punishment than by improving conditions for the soldiers.

events.title: 프랑스 원수가 되다
events.title_en: He was made Marshal of France
events.description: 전쟁이 끝나던 해 프랑스 원수 칭호를 받았다.
events.description_en: In the year the war ended he was given the title of Marshal of France.

events.title: 리프 전쟁에서 프랑스군을 지휘하다
events.title_en: He commanded French forces in the Rif War
events.description: 모로코 리프 지역에서 압델크림이 이끈 반군에 맞서 프랑스군 지휘를 맡았다. 스페인군과 협공해 반군을 진압했다.
events.description_en: In the Rif region of Morocco he took command of French forces against the rebellion led by Abd el-Krim. Fighting alongside Spanish forces, he helped crush the revolt.

events.title: 두메르그 내각의 전쟁장관이 되다
events.title_en: He served as minister of war under Doumergue
events.description: 정치 일선에 나서 두메르그 내각에서 전쟁장관을 지냈다. 은퇴한 군인이 다시 국정에 발을 들인 순간이었다.
events.description_en: He stepped into politics as minister of war in the Doumergue cabinet. It marked the return of a retired soldier to the heart of government.

events.title: 총리가 되어 독일과 휴전을 맺다
events.title_en: He became prime minister and signed an armistice with Germany
events.description: 프랑스가 무너지던 시점에 총리를 맡아 곧바로 독일과 휴전을 추진했다. 항전을 주장한 드골 등과 갈라선 순간이었다.
events.description_en: As France collapsed he took over as prime minister and moved at once to seek an armistice with Germany. It was the moment he broke with de Gaulle and others who called for continued resistance.

events.title: 비시 정부를 세우고 국가주석이 되다
events.title_en: He founded the Vichy government and became head of state
events.description: 프랑스 남부 비시에 새 정부를 세우고 국가주석 자리에 올랐다. 이 정부는 이후 독일에 협력하며 유대인 검거에도 손을 댔다.
events.description_en: He set up a new government in Vichy, in southern France, and became head of state. The regime went on to collaborate with Germany, including in the roundup of Jews.

events.title: 반역죄로 재판받다
events.description: 독일 패망 뒤 프랑스로 돌아와 반역죄로 재판을 받았다. 법정은 사형을 선고했다.
events.description_en: After Germany's defeat he returned to France and was tried for treason. The court sentenced him to death.

events.title: 위섬의 감옥에서 죽다
events.title_en: He died in prison on the Île d'Yeu
events.description: 드골이 사형을 종신형으로 감형해 목숨은 건졌으나, 브르타뉴 앞바다 위섬의 감옥에서 여생을 보내다 죽었다.
events.description_en: De Gaulle commuted his death sentence to life imprisonment, sparing his life, but he spent his remaining years in a prison on the Île d'Yeu off the Breton coast and died there.
